newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Hub Power gain 2.50 percent.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Hub Power gain 2.50 percent.

text.p: Blue chip Hub Power Co Ltd jumped 0.80 rupees, or 2.50 percent, to 32.80 on Thursday on buying sparked by demand for its global depositary receipt (GDR), brokers said.
Turnover of 4,395,500 shares was recorded by mid-session, making Hub Power the most active counter by volume.
"There is both speculative and genuine buying of the stock on demand for its GDR in the international market," dealer Sajjad Mankani said.
Other dealers said the recent devaluation of Pakistan's rupee had helped pushed up the prices of all GDR-linked scrip.
